stock.description: Lai Group Holding Company Limited, primarily an investment holding entity, delivers interior design and fit-out solutions for both residential and commercial clients across Hong Kong. Beyond its core design and fit-out operations, the firm also maintains a portfolio of property holdings. Founded in 1996, Lai Group is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Chun Wah Limited.
